taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-07, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 2831.4 | 17.20 | 17.20
2 | 3567.9 | 2.07 | 19.27
3 | 3454.3 | 21.64 | 40.91
4 | 11701.4 | 4.12 | 45.03
5 | 140416.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-07, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-07 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-07 exhibits a 5-layer geoelectric sequence:
- **Layer 1** (0–17.20 m): 2,831.4 Ω·m (topsoil/overburden)
- **Layer 2** (17.20–19.27 m): 3,567.9 Ω·m 
- **Layer 3** (19.27–40.91 m): 3,454.3 Ω·m (potential saturated zone)
- **Layer 4** (40.91–45.03 m): 11,701.4 Ω·m (transitional bedrock)
- **Layer 5** (>45.03 m): 140,416.4 Ω·m (dense resistive basement)

The consecutive 3-layer resistivity relations are:
- Layers 1–3 ($r_1 < r_2 > r_3$): **K**
- Layers 2–4 ($r_2 > r_3 < r_4$): **H**
- Layers 3–5 ($r_3 < r_4 < r_5$): **A**

The calculated sequence confirms the archived **KHA** curve classification with no discrepancies identified.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
